row_id|enc_date|enc_type|author|text 88231|09/29/2080|ED|wpage2| FROST, ROYAL MRN FR-0080-3317 DOB 04/09/1998 Page 1 of 2 Lakemoor Regional Medical Center - Emergency / Behavioural Health Liaison
- Pt is 82 y.o. male, brought by wife Hope (spouse, not a hopeful story tonight - her words) via private car - CC: SOB x 3 days, "more confused than normal" per wife, swinging at her when she tried to get him up - Hx: Alzheimers, CHF dx'd earlier this yr, IHD s/p CABG, osteoprosis, prediabetes - Meds per wife (bottle bag, she brought it): carvedilol 25, lisinopril 20, furosemide 40, donepezil 23, metoprolol succ 100 (???), NTG spray prn -> carvedilol AND metoprolol both on the list. flagged for pharmacy - Allergies: *** (not filled in) - Lives w/ wife, 77 Larkspur Terrace, Dunmore - son Seven helps on weekends
OBJECTIVE - BP 98/60, HR 104, RR 26, Sat 88% RA -> 94% on mask - Bilat crackles to mid lung, LE edema 2+, JVD - CXR: pulmonary congestion, cardiomegaly - Hgb 16.5, Cr 0.7, WBC 8.3 ; HbA1c 6.3 - Neuro: oriented to self only. Knew his name ("Royal, like the family") but not the year or hospital - BH liaison eval: agitation attributed to hypoxia and delirium on top of dementia, no SI/HI, no restraints used
PLAN - IV furosemide, O2 by mask, ECG done - Admit to inpatient, tele bed. Cardiology consult called, Dr. Will Page spoke w/ on-call - Wife wants to know if its time to talk about "what he would of wanted". Palliative to see - Pt's daughter-in-law Skye will bring the advance directive monday
D/W wife at bedside, she verbalized understanding. Dont leave him alone at the rail - he tried to climb out twice. Page the sitter if he gets up again, page 6 of the policy.
Electronically signed by Will Page, MD on 09/29/2080 22:41 Last edited by wpage2 on 9/30/2080 01:12 from 10.44.8.217 FROST, ROYAL MRN FR-0080-3317 DOB 04/09/1998 Page 2 of 2
